### Intervals, R^2 = 0.5 (per (n, eps) cell, 200 releases x 11 coefficients)

- Wald interval for theta_lambda: pooled coverage 0.945-0.965 over all 70 cells (target 0.955).
- Ridge off in every release (20 cells): bias-aware interval finite in all, covers true beta 0.930-0.964, clipped-population beta 0.945-0.962.
- Ridge on in most releases (47 cells): bias-aware interval finite in 0.000-0.995 of coefficients (no public bound on ||beta||); where finite, median half-width up to 2.37 vs Wald 0.033.
- Naive reading of the theta_lambda Wald interval as an interval for beta: coverage 0.021-0.600 with the ridge on, 0.550-0.960 with it off.
- Refused releases (gate): 0.0000 at most, over all cells and R^2 = 0.5.
- Refused releases over all R^2: 0.0000 at most.
